---
name: 💡 Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature
title: ""
type: Feature
---

Please include:
- Short explanation of the feature.
- Why this would be useful or needed.
- How you imagine it could work.
- (Optional) Links, examples, screenshots, or notes.

Please try to give the issue an appropriate label based on the components of Core Game it likely affects.

If this is an vague idea rather than a specific feature request, please change the issue type to `Idea`. \
If the issue must be further discussed by the full Core Game team before it can be worked on, please change the issue type to `Refinement`.
